segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for the time, Megan. I’ve got you down for the calibration tracking rollout at the Dayton and Findlay plants, 18 named users, and about 1,450 active instruments. Is that still the right scope?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. We may add the Columbus warehouse later, but not before Q3. For now it’s 18 users, mostly quality techs and two supervisors.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. The annual subscription for that is $31,200, and the onboarding package is $4,800 one-time. That includes importing your current asset list, setting up calibration intervals, and two admin training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On invoicing, can you do quarterly billing? Our finance team prefers four invoices instead of the full year up front.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, quarterly is fine. It would be $7,800 per quarter for the subscription, net 30, and the $4,800 onboarding fee would be on the first invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. We need the first invoice dated February 1 if possible. Our budget opens that week, and I don’t want it landing in January.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. If we get the order form signed by January 29, I’ll set the service start date as February 1 and the first invoice date as February 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. What’s realistic for go-live? We have an audit on April 22, so I’d like people using it before then, not the week of.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For your size, six weeks is realistic. If kickoff is February 6, asset import can finish by February 20, training the week of March 4, and go-live March 18. That gives you about a month before the audit.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That timeline is fine. Please send the order form with those dates and quarterly billing. I’ll route it to procurement today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over this afternoon with the 12-month term, February 1 start, quarterly billing, and the March 18 go-live target. Anything else you want reflected?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Just include Columbus as optional expansion later, not part of this purchase. Otherwise we’re good.
